context: A police officer discusses social cases
purpose: Teach: 与野党/惨敗/屈折/コレステロール/ステロイド/草の根/転向/撃つ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、与野党、絶対、議員、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、求められております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: This case requires a coordinated response from both ruling and opposition Diet members, police, and all relevant authorities. We're grateful for everyone's serious commitment.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each clause lands with quiet weight. Professional distance maintained throughout. No rush—each phrase gets its due.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スポーツ界の、本気で、絶対、惨敗、絶対、後の警備、絶対、警察、絶対、大変、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The aftermath of this incident in the sports world has been severe, and the police have had a lot on their hands. We appreciate their dedication.
lines.style: Thoughtful, acknowledging the gravity. Slight pause between clauses. Sincere without performing sincerity. The tone of someone thinking through the implications as he speaks.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被疑者の供述、本気で、絶対、屈折、絶対、した点、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're carefully verifying the suspect's statements, particularly where inconsistencies have appeared. We're being thorough.
lines.style: Precise, procedural. Clipped delivery on key terms. Official register—no wasted breath. Tone suggests competence and caution in equal measure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者、本気で、絶対、コレステロール、絶対、関連の、絶対、病歴、絶対、ありましたか、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Did the victim have any relevant medical history that we should be aware of?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry. Slightly softer than the procedural lines. Leans in slightly—seeking clarification, not conducting. Open, not leading.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。違法薬物、本気で、絶対、ステロイド、絶対、密売、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively investigating the trafficking of controlled substances, including steroids. The investigation is moving forward.
lines.style: Factual, official. Steady tempo. Each point lands clearly. The tone of someone reporting findings without embellishment. Professional certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 草の根、本気で、絶対、市民活動が、絶対、警察に、絶対、情報提供、絶対、しているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand that grassroots citizens' groups have been providing information to the police as well.
lines.style: Conversational but measured. A statement framed as inquiry—inviting confirmation. Thoughtful pause before the observation. Respectful of the community's role.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被疑者、本気で、絶対、転向、絶対、姿勢を、絶対、見せている、絶対、と、警察、絶対、報告しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The suspect has shown signs of a change in attitude and willingness to cooperate. That's what we're reporting.
lines.style: Official, measured. Slight emphasis on 'shown signs'—careful not to overstate. Even pacing. The tone of someone reporting carefully chosen facts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者を、本気で、絶対、撃つ、絶対、動機、絶対、警察、絶対、解明、絶対、進めているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the investigation into the motive for the attack on the victim is still ongoing—you're still working to clarify what happened.
lines.style: Reflective summary. Thoughtful pacing. Acknowledges effort and openness. No finality—the tone of someone recognizing an investigation in progress. Warm but not presumptuous.
